name: DaxLib.SVG.Scale.Normalize
description: Map a value from one value scale to another Used for scaling values to fit within SVG dimensions

parameters.name: fromMin
parameters.description: The minimum value of the original scale

parameters.name: fromMax
parameters.description: The maximum value of the original scale

parameters.name: toMin
parameters.description: The minimum value of the new scale

parameters.name: toMax
parameters.description: The maximum value of the new scale

code:
function 'DaxLib.SVG.Scale.Normalize' =
		(
			inputValue: NUMERIC VAL,
			fromMin: NUMERIC VAL,
			fromMax: NUMERIC VAL,
			toMin: NUMERIC VAL,
			toMax: NUMERIC VAL
		) =>
			
			( ( inputValue - fromMin ) / ( fromMax - fromMin ) ) * ( toMax - toMin ) + toMin
